manual_pass.reason: Lead accepts every finished or stopped run as a valid result (2026-11-16)

interview.hardest_part: Reliably reading small document text, cross-checking an expanding set of rules, and performing precise drags and stamp placements quickly enough to process enough entrants without citations.
interview.likely_failure: Most likely during the early-to-middle workdays: slow document handling or repeated inspection mistakes will cause citations, financial trouble, or excessive wall-clock use, preventing progression beyond roughly days 5–10. Reaching day 29 and then selecting and executing a qualifying ending is substantially less likely.
interview.helpful_mechanics: The game pauses while I reason, early days have simple admission rules, documents remain available for repeated inspection, the rulebook provides explicit guidance, and progress is saved at workday boundaries. Entrants can be handled methodically without reflex-based input.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Small text and overlapping movable documents make visual verification and mouse control error-prone. Each inspection requires many separate clicks and drags, the in-day clock penalizes slow play, rules accumulate, and citations plus living expenses can end the run. The three-hour budget also makes the full 31-day story and a specific successful ending difficult to reach.
